name: AmpFibian
abilities: Bio-electrokinesis - stunning to lethal electric blasts and waves
Electricity absorption and redirection (lightning, energy nets)
Intangibility - shocks whatever he phases through
Becomes pure energy to travel through cables and control technology
Flight; fast swimming and underwater breathing (safe discharge underwater)
Elastic, extending tentacles; boneless squeezing through gaps
weaknesses: Electricity drainers (Phil) and super-dense rubber (Solid Plugg) nullify him
Intangibility cancelled by other intangible beings
summary: A blue jellyfish alien crackling with lightning who phases through walls, rides power lines as pure energy, and swims like a torpedo.
traits: DNA sampled from Ra'ad; Ben was stuck as him in Fused
Blue eyes in Fused, green afterwards
Six tentacles serve as arms and legs
Omnitrix on his mouth in Omniverse
notableFeats: Debuted fused with Ra'ad and stayed stuck until Kevin reset the Ultimatrix (Fused)
Swam the team to Piscciss's core (Deep)
Telepathy used to swap King Xarion's mind (Viktor: The Spoils)
Defeated Ultimate Kevin in a dream (Night of the Living Nightmare)
Shocked Solid Plugg's crew and saved the Screegit (Have I Got a Deal for You)
Defeated Seebik and the Kraaho (Special Delivery)

appearances.designNotes: Blue jellyfish body with white lightning-streak swipes, three skirt-like segments (head/chest/abdomen), six curved tentacles, pupil-less eyes; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

appearances.firstEpisode: Have I Got a Deal for You
notableEpisodes: Have I Got a Deal for You
appearances.designNotes: Altered lightning swipes, pointed rather than curved tentacles, larger green eyes with heavier black outlines; Omnitrix symbol worn on his mouth.

scoring.rationale: Electric utility alien: absorbs and redirects lightning (energy 7), phases through walls, rides power lines and swims fast (mobility 8), and even reads minds. Light body, no space survival, and rubber or energy-drainers leave him helpless.

notes: UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
